test_navigate_to_insights.title: Verify navigation to the Insights page via the sidebar.

steps.action: Log in to the application with valid credentials
steps.expected: User is logged in and default page loads

steps.action: Wait for the page to fully render
steps.expected: All page elements are loaded (no spinners or skeleton loaders)

steps.action: Scroll to the area where Insights widget list should appear
steps.expected: The relevant section of the page is in view

steps.action: Locate Insights widget list on the page
steps.expected: Insights widget list is visible on the page

steps.action: Set up precondition: when Insights tab is selected
steps.expected: Precondition is met (when Insights tab is selected)

test_system_status_link_visible.title: Verify the System Status preset link on the Insights page

steps.action: Click Insights in the left sidebar.
steps.expected: Under Preset Dashboard, a System Status link points at the system status dashboard.

test_open_system_status_dashboard.title: Verify the System Status dashboard opens and loads for a site

steps.action: Click Insights, then System Status, and select the configured site.
steps.expected: The address ends in /insights/systemStatus and the site selector reads the site.

steps.action: Read the Devices, Cameras and Health Monitor panels.
steps.expected: Devices' Total is the sum of its Cameras, Smoke Detector and Thermostats; the Cameras panel's Fixed, PTZ and Zoom add up to its Total, which equals the Devices' camera count; the Health Monitor's online and offline cameras add up to that total.

test_close_system_status_tab.title: Verify the System Status tab can be closed

steps.action: Click Insights in the left sidebar, then click System Status.
steps.expected: The System Status dashboard opens with a site dropdown.

steps.action: Select the configured test site in the dropdown.
steps.expected: The dashboard shows the Devices section.

steps.action: Click the close icon on the System Status tab.
steps.expected: The address is back on /insights and the System Status link shows again under Preset Dashboard.

test_switch_to_widgets_tab.title: Verify switching from Dashboard to Widgets tab

steps.action: Click Insights, then the Widgets tab.
steps.expected: My Dashboards becomes the inactive tab, the page shows Preset Widgets and My Widgets, and the address stays on /insights.

test_create_widget_button_visible.title: Verify the Create New button in the Widgets tab

steps.action: Click Insights, then the Widgets tab.
steps.expected: One enabled Create New button is shown.

test_widget_search_input_visible.title: Verify the widget search box in the Widgets tab

steps.action: Click Insights, then the Widgets tab.
steps.expected: The search box is shown, empty, with the placeholder Search.
